statement: let P := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (Nat.sqrt (n-p)) ∧ (Nat.sqrt (n-p))^2=n-p); ∀ n : ℕ, 4000000000000000000 ≤ n → ((P n).card:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)/(10^6*(Real.log n)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8007 · 给无权陈氏计数中的平方损失一个百万分之一预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8007 · Give the unweighted Chen count an explicit prime-square loss

brief.zh: 先用平方根个数界。log²(x)/√x 在 x≥C 单调下降，在 C 处小于 10⁻⁶。可与同一 n 的无权陈氏下界比较。
brief.en: Bound the count by √n. The ratio log²(x)/√x decreases for x≥C and is below 10⁻⁶ at C. Compare with the unweighted Chen lower bound at the same n.
